reasoning: The icon depicts a mouse cursor arrow surrounded by two concentric click-ripple rings, representing clicking, UI interaction, click-through rate (CTR), or pay-per-click (PPC) advertising. It fits digital marketing, web analytics, frontend event handling, and screen-recording tasks well, though the cursor's placement inside the rings can briefly read as an arrow exiting a target.

qa.fix: A mouse-pointer arrow over concentric click-ripple rings: clicking / click-through (e.g. ad clicks); 'miss target / out of scope', listed first, is not how it reads.
